outer_protocol: 4x4 positive-negative physical trial pairs; 30 train / 10 validation windows
inner_protocol: 3x3 positive-negative physical trial pairs; 20 train / 10 validation windows
regularization: per-window C=(1-lambda)C+lambda*trace(C)/30*I inside each training fold
aggregation: five window probabilities averaged within physical trial, then four pair probabilities averaged per trial
